field.name: id_military_age_requirement
field.comment: Idaho retirement benefits deduction for retired service members: age 62 or older qualifies outright; under 62 qualifies only when employed during the year with enough earned income to have to file a federal return; disabled qualifies at any age (Idaho Code 63-3022A(1)(b); 2025 Form 39R instructions, line 8e). Military retired pay is not exempt without one of these tests.

field.name: id_military_retirement_exemption
field.comment: Idaho retirement benefits deduction for military retired pay (computed): the qualifying pay (ID_Retirement_Benefits_Deduction, per taxpayer), capped at the filing-status maximum less Social Security received (Form 39R Part B line 8f -> line 24 -> Form 40 line 10) (#1330).

field.name: id_military_retirement_taxable
field.comment: ID taxable military retirement after exemption (computed)

field.name: id_retirement_benefits_cap_joint
field.comment: Idaho retirement benefits deduction maximum, married filing jointly: $72,324 for 2025 (Form 39R Part B line 8a; 2025 Form 39R instructions p. 31).

field.name: id_retirement_benefits_cap_single
field.comment: Idaho retirement benefits deduction maximum, single: $48,216 for 2025, reduced by Social Security and Railroad Retirement benefits received (Form 39R Part B line 8a; Idaho Code 63-3022A; 2025 Form 39R instructions p. 31).

field.name: id_tax_rate
field.comment: Idaho individual income tax rate 5.3% effective January 1, 2025 (HB 40; 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet step 4). Was 5.695% for 2024.

field.name: id_zero_bracket_joint
field.comment: Idaho taxable income not taxed, married filing jointly, surviving spouse or head of household: $9,622 for 2025, twice the single figure as in prior years (2024: $4,673 single, $9,346 joint). The 2025 joint figure was not read from the Form 40 worksheet directly; confirm when a joint Idaho scenario is written.

field.name: id_zero_bracket_single
field.comment: Idaho taxable income not taxed, single or married filing separately: $4,811 for 2025 (Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet step 2).
